dogecoin.text: @lopp Dogecoin seems to be already perfect the way it is.

@cryptojewls @maxkeiser I get the sentiment. But dogecoin *literally* is a joke with an infinite supply... because it was build as a joke making fun of all the altcoins. If you want to make a quick buck, investing in it - in the hopes of it going even higher - be my guest. But it will not store value.
